result.summary: Found 3 issues: text truncation problems on restaurant cards and a minor styling inconsistency in the favorite icons.

issues.description: Restaurant names are truncated in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') and the 'Popular right now' section ('Tokumaru Ramei' appears cut off), making it hard to read full names.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card widths accommodate full text or add proper ellipsis handling with adequate spacing so names are fully visible or clearly truncated.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge with no visible partial-card indicator or padding, which may confuse users about scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle peek of the next card or a scroll indicator to signal that the list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently — one appears on a white circular background while the other is on a dark/transparent background, creating visual inconsistency between cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background and contrast treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
